T: New York welcome. Hong Kong kicks.
D: A Hong Kong cop visiting his uncle in New York ends up protecting a supermarket from a street gang.
P: Serve the mains when the bikers trash Elaine's supermarket.
S: Toasted rye topped with pastrami, sauerkraut and melted Swiss cheese

Rye bread squares stacked with pastrami, sauerkraut and Swiss, toasted until the cheese melts, with a dab of Russian dressing and a pickle on a pick. Cut 6 slices of rye bread into quarters and toast lightly at 200C for 4 minutes. Top each with folded pastrami from 250g, a little drained sauerkraut from 150g and a square of Swiss cheese from 150g. Bake 5 minutes until melted. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp horseradish and chopped pickle. Dab on each bite and spear with a slice of dill pickle.
Pan-fried pork and garlic chive dumplings with black vinegar
Pork, garlic chives, ginger and sesame oil folded into wrappers, pan-fried until crisp underneath, then steamed. Black vinegar dip.
soft steamed buns stuffed with chicken, mushroom, spring onion and ginger in sticky oyster sauce

Fluffy steamed buns filled with chicken, shiitake and spring onion in oyster sauce. Mix the chicken, shiitake, spring onion, ginger, oyster sauce, soy and sesame oil. Stir-fry the filling until cooked and sticky. Open the bao and spoon in the filling. Steam until hot through.
6 dried shiitake mushrooms, soaked and chopped@Pantry
M: Ginger and spring onion lobster noodles
shell-on tails wok-fried in light oyster sauce, over crisp-edged soft egg noodles

Lobster tails cut through the shell and wok-fried with ginger and spring onion in a light oyster sauce, piled over crisp-edged soft egg noodles. Cut 4 lobster tails through the shell into chunks, or use 800g king prawns. Dust in cornflour and fry in a hot wok for 2 minutes, then set aside. Pan-fry 400g boiled egg noodles in oil until crisp underneath. Stir-fry 50g sliced ginger and 6 spring onion lengths, add the lobster, 2 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine and 150ml chicken stock and toss 2 minutes. Pour over the noodles.
Crispy battered pork with pineapple and red capsicum in sweet and sour sauce, over jasmine rice

Pork shoulder pieces in a light batter, fried crisp, tossed in a sauce of pineapple, capsicum, vinegar, sugar and tomato sauce. Toss 700g diced pork shoulder in egg and 100g cornflour and fry at 180C until crisp. Simmer chunks of half a pineapple and a red capsicum with 80ml vinegar, 80g sugar and 80ml tomato sauce, then thicken. Toss the pork through and serve with 300g jasmine rice.
W: Chilled almond milk jelly cubes with lychees and mandarin segments
Milk set with gelatine and almond extract, cut into cubes, served with lychees and mandarin segments in syrup.
K: Uncle Bill's wedding iced jasmine tea
Iced jasmine tea with lychee syrup, lime and lychees in the glass

Fragrant jasmine tea steeped strong, sweetened with lychee syrup, poured over ice with whole lychees and a twist of lime. Heat 1L water to just off the boil and steep 5 tsp jasmine tea for 4 minutes, then strain and cool. Drain a 565g tin of lychees, keeping the syrup. Stir 150ml of the syrup and the juice of a lime into the tea and chill for an hour. Fill four tall glasses with ice and a few lychees, pour in the tea and finish with a twist of lime peel.
